alt: A sequence of wedding preparations shows people assembling a flower arch, recovering from a toppled cake setup and rain-soaked decorations, then celebrating beneath a finished floral arch at a garden wedding.

checks.alt: passed: accurately describes the visible progression without printing the full idiom
checks.anatomy_and_pose: passed: foreground and inset figures have coherent heads, torsos, limbs, hands and celebratory/working poses; no conspicuous extra or missing limbs
checks.arch_cake_decoration_contact_physics: passed: floral arch elements attach plausibly to the frame, the cake tiers sit on a stand/table, fallen setup components are supported by the ground, and ribbons, chairs, tables and flowers have plausible contact, overlap and gravity relationships
checks.meaning_and_progress: passed: the upper sequence uses arrows to show repeated wedding-preparation setbacks (an unstable arch, a toppled cake/table setup, and rain disrupting decorations) followed by successful completion and a joyful wedding scene, clearly conveying that a good outcome required repeated overcoming of difficulties
checks.style: passed: consistent warm colored-pencil outlines, soft watercolor shading, paper texture and storybook illustration treatment throughout
checks.text_brand_watermark: passed: no readable text, brand marks, logos or watermark visible
